articles.summary: Orthofix Medical Inc. (NASDAQ:OFIX), a leading global medical technology company, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and revised its full-year 2026 net sales and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA guidance. Unless otherwise noted, pro forma results exclude the impact of the discontinued M6™ product lines. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Total reported net sales of $207.9 million, representing an increase of 1% on a reported basis and 2% on a pro forma constant currency basis compared with the prior year period. Reported net loss of $(6.1) million and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA of $26.0 million. Revised full-year 2026 pro forma net sales guidance to $825 million to $830 million and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA guidance to $86 million to $88 million, reflecting third-quarter performance and the anticipated fourth quarter impact of actions to improve U.S. Spine execution, instrument set availability and asset productivity.
